|translation='''Title:''' Imperial Domination.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any location. If you control that location and did not Force drain there, the opponent cannot generate Force there on the next turn.

'''Lore:'''
When Vader's army shows the prestige of the Emperor's edict in various places, Rebel resources and lifelines are quickly shut off.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Opponent generates no Force is フォースを発生させることができない.
